ports.notes: shared central lane, combines output from both furnace rows; pass-through to (-0.5,5.5)

tiling_notes: Each of the 3 lanes is an unbroken 12-tile pass-through from y_min to y_max; stacking copies vertically extends every lane, export row feeds the next copy's import row directly.
layout_pattern: layouts/smelter_module_ports.md ("Plate on the inside") - same pattern as 4x2-stone-furnaces-w-upgrade-spacing but with no coal lanes, since electric-furnace runs on electricity rather than burned fuel.
